name: What are the common signs of water damaged drywall?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of water damaged drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damaged drywall often presents with visual cues like discoloration, swelling, or bubbling paint. You might also notice a soft, spongy texture when pressing on the wall. A musty odor, indicating mold growth, is another strong indicator. These signs typically appear when water has penetrated the drywall, whether from a leaky pipe, roof issue, or flood, and early detection is key to preventing further structural damage and mold spread.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include discoloration, swelling, bubbling paint, a soft texture, or a musty odor.
